description: This file defines structures and functions related to managing environment variables within the Lighttpd web server, including creation, modification, duplication, and removal of environment data, as well as handling CGI environment variables.
external_methods: LI_API void li_environment_set(liEnvironment *env, const gchar *key, size_t keylen, const gchar *val, size_t valuelen)
LI_API void li_environment_insert(liEnvironment *env, const gchar *key, size_t keylen, const gchar *val, size_t valuelen)
LI_API void li_environment_remove(liEnvironment *env, const gchar *key, size_t keylen)
LI_API GString* li_environment_get(liEnvironment *env, const gchar *key, size_t keylen)
LI_API GString* li_environment_dup_pop(liEnvironmentDup *envdup, const gchar *key, size_t keylen)
LI_API void li_environment_dup2cgi(liVRequest *vr, liEnvironmentDup *envdup, liAddEnvironmentCB callback, gpointer param)

methods.name: li_environment_init
methods.description: Initializes a new environment object with an empty hash table.

methods.name: li_environment_reset
methods.description: Removes all entries from the environment, resetting it to an empty state.

methods.name: li_environment_clear
methods.description: Destroys the environment table and frees associated resources.

methods.name: li_environment_set
methods.description: Overwrites the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: li_environment_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new environment variable if it does not exist or leaves unchanged if it does.

methods.name: li_environment_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: li_environment_make_dup
methods.description: Creates a read-only duplicate of the current environment.

methods.name: li_environment_dup_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the value of a specified variable from the duplicate environment.

methods.name: li_environment_dup2cgi
methods.description: Transfers environment variables from a duplicate environment to a CGI request, invoking a callback for each variable.
